title: fix(ui): a view a read-only package ships hides only Delete in Manage views and opens its view panel read-only
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVwX4pUdM1qvNLSqRZNSvv3)_

Fixes #35974

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no authorable metadata changes (Metadata-protocol: none)

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgW85kwjGaz7HqsmEuv

This implements ruling B on this card: maintainer comment 7058654416, which amends 7057139393, and the claim amendment 7058659088. `@object-ui/plugin-view` gains one optional field, `ViewTabItem.definitionReadonly`. Restoring a shipped view to its factory version from the list page is follow-up #36011 and is not in this PR.

## 维护者速读

- 管理员在只读包自带的列表视图上：「管理视图」里不再出现删除；重命名、置顶、设为默认照常可用并能保存；「查阅视图配置」打开只读的设置面板，没有保存。列表选项菜单里的重命名也恢复提供。
- 属于列表页重做专题：替管理员去掉点了必被服务器拒绝的两个入口（删除、保存视图定义），保留服务器其实会接受的操作。
- 出错时最坏是某个按钮多出或少了；读不到包列表时一切照旧提供、服务器照旧拒绝，可直接撤回本改动。
- 要你做什么：现在不需要。

## What changes

These rules apply to a view a read-only package ships, for example one of the showcase package's views:

- **Manage views** hides Delete on that view's row. Rename, pin and set as default stay offered, because they land in the package's customization pair (see the measurements). The configuration entry reads "View config" (Eye icon) and opens the panel read-only.
  - **Lock icon:** none. The row is no longer marked `readonly` for this, so the lock is not drawn: the row's label, pin and default are writable. Only its definition is not.
- **View panel**: opened through "View config", the panel is read-only. The inspector gets `readOnly`, no edit reaches the list, and there is no draft bar. The footer shows only Close.
- **List options menu**: #35975 hid Rename for such a view. Rename is offered again, after one rename was measured to land (see below). The calculation menu stays hidden, as #35975 left it.
- Unchanged: a shared view the console saved into the customization package, the reader's own view, and the toolbar's personal list state (it saves to the reader's preferences).
- Fail-open, as in #35975: while the package list is unread, when the read fails, or when the list leaves the package out, every offer stays as before and the server's refusal still applies.

The code changes are:

- `@object-ui/plugin-view` `ViewTabItem`: new optional `definitionReadonly?: boolean`, documented in its JSDoc. In `ManageViewsDialog`, `deleteAction` is dropped and the config label switches to `view.showViewConfig`. Nothing else reads the field. `readonly` still wins when both are set. Without the field a row behaves exactly as before. `ViewTabBar` does not read it. This replaces the unpublished `readonlyConfigViewable` that the option-A rounds of this branch had added.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `view.showViewConfig`, with real text in all 11 locales. zh-Hant is generated from zh-Hans (`gen:zh-hant`).
- `@object-ui/app-shell`:
  - `useObjectViewTitleSwitcher` adds `definitionReadonly: true` to a saved row whose served `_packageId` the session package list carries as read-only. It reads the list through `usePackagesRefusingSaves(ids)` in `useStudioDesignGate.ts`: the same `packageStudioPosture(...) === 'view'` verdict, the same session-held `fetchSessionPackages` read (at most one GET /api/v1/packages per new package id per session; concurrent checks share it) and the same fail-open as `usePackageRefusesSaves`.
  - `ViewConfigPanel` gains a `readOnly` prop. `ObjectView` passes it in edit mode from the same `refusingPackages` set that flags the rows, for the open view and for the view the panel was opened for (round 2, below).
  - `ObjectView`'s options-menu Rename drops the `!activeViewPackageRefusesSaves` gate.
- `@object-ui/console` is listed in the changeset because it bundles the private app-shell.

Read first (risk order):
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewTitleSwitcher.tsx`: the `viewTabItems` map that sets `definitionReadonly` from `refusingPackages`.
2. `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/ManageViewsDialog.tsx`: the `deleteAction` line and the config-entry label.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`: the Rename gate lift and the panel's `readOnly` prop.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.readOnlyPackageViewSaves-35974.test.tsx packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/readonlyViewMenus-10209.test.tsx` passes. The case 'Manage views: the shipped row offers everything but Delete and "View config"; the custom row is unchanged' drives the real dialog from the real ObjectView.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.readOnlyPackageViewSaves-35974.test.tsx` is new, with 8 cases. It runs the real `ObjectView` with the real `ManageViewsDialog` held open, `fetchSessionPackages` stubbed, and the panel replaced by a stand-in that records its props.
  - The shipped row has pin and set default, no lock, and its menu holds Rename, View config, Set as default and Pin, with no Delete. The custom row keeps all five entries with "Edit view config".
  - The shipped row's "View config" opens the panel in edit mode with `readOnly: true`. The custom row's entry opens it with `readOnly: false`. The panel opened on each view directly agrees.
  - The reader's own view is unchanged.
  - An unread package list and a failed read each leave every offer in place.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.readOnlyPackageView-35933.test.tsx`: the shipped-view case now expects `onRenameView` to be wired, and the calculation menu stays absent.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx` (the panel's harness) has a top-level describe, 'ViewConfigPanel — read-only (objectstack#35974)', with 2 cases: Close only and no draft bar; the inspector is read-only and relays no patch.
- `ui/packages/plugin-view/src/__tests__/readonlyViewMenus-10209.test.tsx` (the dialog's read-only harness) has a top-level describe, 'ManageViewsDialog `definitionReadonly` (objectstack#35974)', with 4 cases:
  - the flagged row offers rename, View config, set default and pin, with no Delete and no lock;
  - View config calls `onConfigView`;
  - without the flag nothing changes (six entries, "Edit view config", Delete present), which pins the no-flag behaviour;
  - `readonly` wins (no menu, lock drawn).

<details><summary>Affected suites: 274 files passed</summary>

`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-view/ packages/i18n/ packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView packages/app-shell/src/views/ViewConfigPanel packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewTitleSwitcher packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useStudioDesignGate packages/app-shell/src/layout/SidebarItemMenu` at `c17e284d` gave `Test Files 274 passed (274)` · `Tests 3589 passed | 13 skipped (3602)` · `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The later head `2e34976c` changes only the changeset. The whole `@object-ui/app-shell` package is declared to CI's Test UI shards.

</details>

<details><summary>Type-check: plugin-view, i18n, app-shell exit 0</summary>

`pnpm --dir ui --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter @object-ui/plugin-view --filter @object-ui/i18n --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` at `2e34976c` gave three `Done` and `VERDICT command-exit 0`. Each package's `tsconfig.test.json` leg compiles its test files.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations: each ruling-B gate reverted once, restore proven</summary>

Every mutation went through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` inside a script with an EXIT/INT/TERM trap. In each, the anchor went from 1 hit to 0 and the blob changed. After restore the blob equalled HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty. Under the vitest alias, `@object-ui/plugin-view` resolves to `src`, so no `dist/` is in the path. The suites used were the three ObjectView and plugin-view files at `3f5c9478`, 28 cases.

1. Delete gate (`isReadonly || definitionReadonly ? undefined : onDelete` → `isReadonly ? …`): 3 failed.
2. Label (`showViewConfig` → `editViewConfig`): 4 failed.
3. App-shell flag (`{ ...item, definitionReadonly: true } : item` → `item : item`): 3 failed.
4. Rename lift (put `!activeViewPackageRefusesSaves &&` back): 1 failed (the 35933 case).
5. Panel prop (`readOnly={…}` → `readOnly={false}`): 2 failed.
6. Derivation (`!isReadonly && !!view.definitionReadonly` → `!!view.definitionReadonly`): stayed green, 28 of 28. `readonly` already drops both entries the flag changes, so the check could not be observed. `c17e284d` removes it, and the code now matches the ablated form.

The panel's own guards (footer, `handlePatch`, inspector `readOnly`, draft bar) were each ablated in the earlier round, and each turned its own case red. Those lines are unchanged since.

</details>

<details><summary>Built declaration: the one widening</summary>

`pnpm --dir ui --filter @object-ui/plugin-view build` at `2e34976c` was followed by `diff -r` of the declarations against a dist built from main-equivalent plugin-view source. The only difference is in `ViewTabBar.d.ts`: `definitionReadonly?: boolean;` plus its JSDoc. The other 12 `.d.ts` files are byte-identical.

</details>

<details><summary>Measurements and browser check (showcase stand, console dev server on this branch)</summary>

The stand: backend `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p 4417` in `examples/app-showcase`, and a Console Vite server on :5417 (`--strictPort`) proxying to it. Signed in as the seeded admin, on `showcase_task`, view `showcase_task.in_progress` (shipped by `com.example.showcase`, `writable: false`). Both servers were stopped by PID afterwards.

What the server refuses, measured before ruling B:

- The panel's save (`PUT /api/v1/meta/view/...?mode=draft`, naming no package) → `403`, "save it into 'com.example.showcase.custom'".
- Delete (`DELETE /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.in_progress`) → `403`.

What lands, through the UI on this branch:

- Before: the row shows no lock, with Pin and the default star present. The menu holds Rename, View config, Set as Default and Pin View, with no Delete.
- Rename to "Renamed In Progress": `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` → `201` (created). Then `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/showcase_task.in_progress?package=com.example.showcase.custom` → `200`, "Saved customization overlay", seq 1.
- Pin: ensure-customization → `200`, then the same PUT → `200`, seq 2.
- Set as default: the shipped default `showcase_task.default` is cleared (PUT `?package=com.example.showcase.custom` → `200`, seq 3), then `in_progress` is set (PUT → `200`, seq 4). No toast was shown.
- After a reload: the row reads "Renamed In Progress" with the default badge, which is the only default badge. The pin control reads "Unpin View". The menu holds Rename, View config and Unpin View, with no Delete.
- View config opens the panel. Save: absent. Discard: absent. Footer: "Close". The label input shows "Renamed In Progress". The only enabled controls are section expanders, one input and Close. Nothing was written while the panel was open.

</details>

## Round 2 (L2 S1)

The L2 record 7060948822 raised should-fix S1. The panel's read-only verdict came from a second, per-view hook (`usePackageRefusesSaves`) that answers "not read-only" until its own read settles, while the Manage views rows read `usePackagesRefusingSaves`. Two failures followed:

- "View config" on a shipped row opened from another package's view drew an editable frame first.
- A verdict arriving after an edit stranded the edit: no Discard, the list preview kept the edit, and the read-only panel showed it in place of the stored view.

The fix:

- **Same verdict.** `ObjectView` judges the panel from the `refusingPackages` set the rows are flagged from. `useObjectViewTitleSwitcher` now returns that set.
  - The panel is judged for the open view and also for the view the panel was opened for (`configTargetId`, cleared when the panel closes). The view switch from a non-active row lands in a router transition, after the panel opens.
  - `activeViewPackageRefusesSaves` is still used for the calculation-menu gate.
- **Late verdict.** When `ViewConfigPanel` turns read-only (edit mode) with unsaved or relayed edits, it runs Discard's revert without closing: the opening values are replayed through `onViewUpdate`, so the list preview returns to the stored view, and the buffer resets to the stored view.
- **Answers kept per package.** `usePackagesRefusingSaves` keeps each package's answer for the session as it lands. A change to the list of ids (a refetch that brings a view of a new package) no longer blanks the set, so an open panel cannot flip back to savable.

New cases:

- the 35974 ObjectView file, "View config" on a shipped row while another package's view is open: every render of the open panel after the click has `readOnly: true`. The panel stand-in records each render.
- the 35974 ObjectView file, a new package id joining the list takes back none of what is known (a hook probe).
- `ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx`, a verdict landing after an edit: the opening columns are replayed, the panel shows them, it is read-only with no Discard or Save, it stays open, and a later edit relays nothing.
- `ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx`, a verdict landing before any edit relays nothing.

<details><summary>Round 2 ablations: each guard once, all red, restore proven</summary>

Run at `60a4b3b7` through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in a trap script, over the 35974 ObjectView file and `ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx` (17 cases). In each, the anchor went from 1 hit to 0 and the blob changed. After restore the blob equalled HEAD and `git diff HEAD` was empty, and the hash-object check passed for all three files.

1. Late discard (`revertEdits()` → `void 0`): 1 failed, the late-verdict case.
2. Same verdict (`readOnly={viewConfigPanelReadOnly}` → the old `activeViewPackageRefusesSaves` expression): 1 failed, the non-active-row case.
3. Opened-for target (drop `|| viewRefusesSaves(configTargetId)`): 1 failed, the non-active-row case. This shows the transition frame is real.
4. Per-package answers (`setAnswers(null)` at the start of each read): 1 failed, the hook case.

</details>

<details><summary>Round 2 runs</summary>

- `origin/main` was merged twice, both times cleanly except the one #36031 line above. HEAD is now `224cb17f`. The app-shell dependency closure was rebuilt after the first merge: `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, 68 of 68 successful.
- Suites at `5f754fbc` (`224cb17f` changes only the changeset). The run covered `packages/plugin-view/`, `packages/i18n/`, the app-shell `ObjectView*`, `ViewConfigPanel*`, `objectViewTitleSwitcher*`, `objectViewViewCrud*`, `useStudioDesignGate*` and `SidebarItemMenu*` files, and `AppContent.draftSaveKeepsList-35932.test.tsx`. Result: `Test Files 276 passed (276)` · `Tests 3608 passed | 13 skipped (3621)` · `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- Type-check: plugin-view, i18n and app-shell at `ec456e0d`, three `Done`. App-shell again at `5f754fbc`, after #36031's app-shell change: `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Known nit (L2 delta N3, 7062534252), not fixed on this head: `configTargetId` in `ObjectView.tsx` clears only when the panel closes, so browser back/forward with the panel open can leave it read-only on a savable view until it is reopened. It only fails toward read-only.
- A view a kernel package ships keeps every offer, because the package list leaves kernel packages out. This is the same as #35975.
- Restoring a shipped view's factory version from the list page (undoing the overlay that rename, pin and default write) is #36011.
- #36031 has landed. Merging it (`5f754fbc`) kept both of its `onAfterChange={handleDraftBarChange}` and this PR's `readOnly={viewConfigPanelReadOnly}` on `ViewConfigPanel`. They compose: `handleDraftBarChange` runs only from the draft bar, which a read-only panel does not mount, and the late-verdict discard below goes through `onViewUpdate`.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gate families: 41 derived, 41 run, 0 NOT MEASURED, all exit 0</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `224cb17f` derived 41 commands from 22 paths against merge base `55cd85fc7`. All 41 exited 0 at `224cb17f`. `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/` gave `Test Files 172 passed | 2 skipped (174)`.

`pnpm check:changeset-fixed` was also run, exit 0. Its roster lives under `.changeset/`, where this PR edits a file, and it is outside the derivation.

`dispatch-gates --ran` gave "41 derived, 41 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN". `origin/main` has since moved to `615d9954` (2 commits); the tool reports that neither touches what the derivation reads.

The type-check lanes, the artifact-roster families and the wide-population families are CI's; their check-runs are the record.

</details>

<details><summary>Clause-② measurement: yes (widening)</summary>

`ViewTabItem.definitionReadonly` is an optional field on a type exported from `@object-ui/plugin-view`'s entry. When it is absent, behaviour is unchanged, which the plugin-view case 'without the flag' pins. `@object-ui/i18n` adds one locale key. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, and its new hook and prop are not re-exported.

</details>

Overlap: `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD` at `224cb17f` merges cleanly with `origin/main` (`55cd85fc`, which contains #36031) and with #36054, #36038, #36026 and #36024. `VERDICT clean exit 0`.
